prompt.es: Escribe el centro de una charla con inversión, regla de tres y pregunta retórica.

answer.text: Every night, millions of us do the same thing. We lie in bed, we pick up the phone, and we say, just five more minutes. But who has ever stopped after five minutes? Nobody. Never have we had so many tools to talk to each other, yet rarely do we feel rested. Not only do we lose sleep, but we also lose focus, energy and patience. Think about your last bad day at work or school. Was it the lack of ideas? Or was it the lack of sleep? Here is what I suggest: a simple plan with three rules. First, leave the phone outside your bedroom. Second, turn off the screen one hour before bed. Third, read a book instead. Little did I know that three small rules would change my mornings. Seldom have I felt so calm and so awake. So tonight, try it. Put your phone down, close your eyes and give your body the rest it needs.
accepted: Every night, millions of us do the same thing. We lie in bed, we pick up the phone, and we say, just five more minutes. But who has ever stopped after five minutes? Nobody. Think about your last bad day at work or school. Was it the lack of ideas? Or was it the lack of sleep? Here is what I suggest: a simple plan with three rules. First, leave the phone outside your bedroom. Second, turn off the screen one hour before bed. Third, read a book instead. Little did I know that three small rules would change my mornings. Seldom have I felt so calm and so awake. So tonight, try it. Put your phone down, close your eyes and give your body the rest it needs.

Every evening, most of us repeat the same habit. We take the phone to bed and we scroll for one more minute. Why do we do it? Because it feels harmless. Never have we been so connected, yet rarely do we feel calm. Not only does the screen steal our sleep, but it also steals our focus, our energy and our patience. So I suggest three simple rules. First, charge the phone in the kitchen. Second, switch off the screen an hour before bed. Third, read a few pages of a book. Seldom have I slept so well as in the week I tried it. So tonight, try it, and tell a friend how you feel tomorrow. Is it really so hard to put a phone down? I bet it is easier than you think.

feedback.es: Un buen centro de charla usa una inversión (Never have we…), una pregunta retórica y una regla de tres, sin abusar del énfasis.

origin.text: Tema: el móvil y el sueño. Escribe en inglés el centro de una charla de unas 130–220 palabras: incluye al menos una inversión enfática (Never have we…, Rarely do we…, Not only do we… but…, Little did I know…), una regla de tres (anuncia «three rules», «three steps»… y enuméralas) y una pregunta retórica.
